Description

A Freehold Vacant Property Comprising a Ground Floor & Lower Ground Floor Solicitors with A First Floor Apartment

An opportunity to acquire a substantial mixed-use property situated in the town of Rhymney. The property comprises a spacious commercial premises arranged over the ground and lower ground floor, extending to approximately 250 sq m, together with a three-bedroom first-floor apartment extending to approximately 50 sq m, according to the EPC. The property benefits from double glazing, rear access with a double garage and additional off-road parking for two vehicles.

Ground Floor The main space has been divided to create a reception area and two meeting rooms at the front and three meeting rooms, a staff area, and a W.C. to the rear.
Lower Ground Floor Two meeting rooms, kitchen area, storage room, double garage and W.C.
First Floor Three bedrooms, kitchen, lounge/dining room and bathroom accessed via a private entrance off the street and from the solicitors.
Viewings Via Auction House Wales.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION Buying at auction is a contractual commitment.
